resources.string: Columns of glyphs falling in three depths, glowing heads, long fading trails.
A drifting plexus of glowing nodes; signals run along its links.
Light caught in motion: slanted panels drifting, streaks racing past.
A city of towers in blue haze at night, seen from a rooftop ledge.
A glowing wireframe land running to a hot pink horizon, gliding toward you.
The striped outrun sun over a glowing grid that glides toward you, under the stars.
A circuit board at work: packets of light racing along its traces, flashing at vias, lighting up its chips.
